y-m-77-01.title: Ukuhlola amanani ombiko wesantya sokuziswa kohambo lokuya nokubuya
y-m-77-01.goal: Hlola ngokubala ukuba isantya esiphakathi sohambo lokuya nokubuya sisenokungalingani nomndilili olula wesantya esibini, uze uthi balingana nini.
y-m-77-01.material: Umqhubi wokuziswa wenza uhambo lokuya nokubuya kumgama omnye ongama-12 km. Ukuya, umqhubi wahamba ngama-30 km ngeyure, kwaye ukubuya, ngama-20 km ngeyure (cinga ukuba akukho kuyeka kwaye isantya sihlala sinjalo kwinyawo nganye). Ingxelo yomsebenzi osebenza naye iyisebenza ngolu hlobo lulandelayo.
y-m-77-01.thinking.0: Fumana umgca kwingxelo otshibiwe ngaphandle kwesizathu
y-m-77-01.thinking.1: Hlola ixabiso usebenzisa iingcaciso zomgama olipheleleyo nexesha elipheleleyo
y-m-77-01.thinking.2: Yenza imibini emininzi yezantya ehambelana neemeko
y-m-77-01.prereq.0: Kulo msebenzi, 'H3' yilebhile kuphela yobunzima nenqanaba lenkxaso kule nkcazelo yemveliso. Ayithethi ukuba iMinistry of Education yabela esi sifundo kwibanga elithile. Cinga ukuba imathematika yemisebenzi yesikolo samabanga aphezulu iphathwa kubunzima obuphezulu, kwaye sele uyazi imilinganiselo, iipesenti, imindilili, namabinzana anonobumba enqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi.
y-m-77-01.prereq.1: Isantya = umgama ÷ ixesha, intsingiselo yomndilili (inqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi)
y-m-77-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kumsebenzi womsebenzi osebenza naye ongenasiseko okanye ongachanekanga.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye, wahlule ukuba uyathwala nje iimeko zengxaki (umgama, isantya) okanye wenza isibakala esitsha.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana ixesha elithathwe ukuya nexesha elithathwe ukubuya, bhala isixa, uze ubeke eli xabiso ecaleni kwebalo lexesha kwingxelo ukuze uthelekise.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukuya: hamba i-12 km ngama-30 km ngeyure.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.1: Ukubuya: buya i-12 km ngama-20 km ngeyure.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.2: Isantya esiphakathi ngumndilili wezantya ezimbini, ngoko (30+20)÷2 = 25 km/h.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.3: Uhambo lokuya nokubuya lwama-24 km lunokwenziwa ngama-25 km ngeyure, ngoko ixesha elithathwayo li-24÷25 = 0.96 iiyure.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.explain: Imigca 1 no-2 ikopa nje iimeko, ngoko ichanekile. Umgca 3 yindawo apho ingxaki iqala khona. Isantya esiphakathi 'ngumgama opheleleyo ÷ ixesha eliphelele', kodwa nangona amaxesha okuya nokubuya ahlukile, izantya ezimbini zathathelwa umndilili ngobunzima obulinganayo. Enyanisweni, ukuya kuthatha 12÷30=0.4 iiyure kwaye ukubuya kuthatha 12÷20=0.6 iiyure, ngoko uhambo lonke luthatha iyure e-1, kwaye isantya esiphakathi si-24÷1=24 km/h. Umgca 4 usebenzisa u-25 ovela kumgca 3 njengoko unjalo, nto leyo enika ixesha elingachanekanga le-0.96 iiyure. Nokuba ukhethe umgca 3 okanye umgca 4, ubone umgca ongachanekanga, kodwa isizathu singumgca 3.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.prompt: Cinga ukuba indlela efanayo ihanjwa ngesantya sika-a km ngeyure ukuya nesika-b km ngeyure ukubuya. Yenza imibini emibini eyahlukileyo (a, b) apho isantya esiphakathi sohambo lonke lokuya nokubuya (umgama opheleleyo ÷ ixesha eliphelele) linani lemvelo. A no-b ngamanani emvelo ahlukeneyo asuka ku-10 ukuya ku-100, kwaye umgama wecala elinye awunamsebenzi. (30, 20) sele inikiwe njengomzekelo, ngoko yishiye. (a, b) kunye (b, a) zibalwa njengomzekelo ofanayo.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.0: Misela umgama wecala elinye ube ngama-12 km, uze kumntu ngamnye okhethiweyo (a, b), ufumane ixesha lokuya nexesha lokubuya uze uzidibanise.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kwimibini emininzi ekhethiweyo, lungelelanisa kwitheyibhile ukuba umgama opheleleyo owahlulwe ngexesha eliphelele linani lemvelo na, uze ujonge oko kuqhelekileyo kwimibini enika inani lemvelo.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c1: A no-b ngamanani emvelo asuka ku-10 ukuya ku-100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda wenze u-a no-b babe ngamanani emvelo asuka ku-10 ukuya ku-100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c3: (30, 20) sele inikiwe njengomzekelo. Zama ukufumana umbini owahlukileyo.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Isantya esiphakathi sohambo lokuya nokubuya linani lemvelo.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Isantya esiphakathi sohambo lokuya nokubuya alilonani lemvelo. Bala umgama opheleleyo nexesha eliphelele kwakhona.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.explain: Ngokomzekelo, ukuba umgama wecala elinye ngu-d, ixesha li-d/a+d/b kwaye isantya esiphakathi si-2ab/(a+b). Kwi-(60, 40) ngu-48, kwi-(40, 10) ngu-16, kwaye kwi-(60, 30) ngu-40. Nawuphi na umbini owukhethayo, isantya esiphakathi singaphantsi okanye silingana nomndilili olula wezantya ezimbini. Silingana nomndilili olula kuphela xa izantya ezimbini ziyafana.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.prompt: Cacisela osebenza naye 'kutheni umndilili ungeyonto 25'. Sebenzisa amaxesha okuya nokubuya njengobungqina bakho, uze wongeze isivakalisi esinye malunga nokuba zikho na iimeko apho umndilili olula wezantya ezimbini uchanekile.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ixesha lokuya nexesha lokubuya njengamanani.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.1: Zama ukuqala ngesivakalisi esithelekisa ixesha elibaliweyo nge-25 (0.96 iiyure) nexesha elithathwa ngokwenene.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uthe ngamazwi akho ukuba amaxesha okuya nokubuya ayahluka?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba unike ixabiso elibaliweyo ukusuka kumgama opheleleyo nexesha eliphelele njengenani?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uchaze imeko enye ye 'meko apho umndilili olula uchanekile'?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.0: Isantya esiphakathi singumgama opheleleyo owahlulwe ngexesha eliphelele. Ukuya kuthatha 12÷30=0.4 iiyure kwaye ukubuya kuthatha 12÷20=0.6 iiyure, ngoko kuthatha iyure e-1 zizonke, kwaye ekubeni umqhubi wahamba ama-24 km, kungama-24 km/h. Ukubuya kucotha ngakumbi, ngoko kuthatha ixesha elide, yiyo loo nto ingeyonto 25. Umndilili olula uchanekile xa izantya ezimbini ziyafana, okanye xa amaxesha ezinyawo ezimbini efana.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba umqhubi wayehambe ngama-25, kwakufanele ukuba kuthathe 24÷25=0.96 iiyure, kodwa enyanisweni kuthatha 0.4+0.6=1 iyure. Ixesha elichithwe kwisantya esicotha ngakumbi lide, ngoko umndilili ngama-24, ongaphantsi kwama-25. Ukuba izantya zokuya nokubuya zazifana, umndilili olula wawuya kuba nokuchaneka.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Impendulo enika imeko yokuba umndilili olula uchanekile kuphela 'xa izantya ziyafana' nayo iyamkelwa.

y-m-77-03.title: Iindleko zokupakisha ibhokisi: ingaba umgaqo omnye unika ixabiso eliphantsi kakhulu?
y-m-77-03.goal: Bonisa ngokubala ukuba umgaqo othi 'sebenzisa iibhokisi ezininzi kangangoko ezixabisa ngaphantsi kwinto nganye' awuqinisekisi iindleko eziphantsi kakhulu kolu myalelo, uze wenze iindlela ezininzi zokupakisha ezanelisa iimeko.
y-m-77-03.material: Indawo yokugcina ifuna ukuthumela iindawo ezili-100 ezahlulwe zaba ziindidi ezimbini zeebhokisi. Ibhokisi enkulu (L) ibamba iindawo ezili-12 ubuninzi kwaye ixabisa i-1,500 won ngebhokisi, kwaye ibhokisi encinci (S) ibamba iindawo ezi-8 ubuninzi kwaye ixabisa i-1,100 won ngebhokisi. Iibhokisi zinokushiya izithuba ezingenanto, kodwa zonke iindawo ezili-100 kufuneka zipakishwe. Nawaphi na amanani eebhokisi anokusetyenziswa. Umsebenzi omnye wayibanga ukuba iindleko eziphantsi kakhulu zinjalo.
y-m-77-03.thinking.0: Ukugweba ukuba umgaqo (ukuqhubela phambili) usebenza na
y-m-77-03.thinking.2: Ukufumana iimeko apho umgaqo ngokuqinisekileyo usebenza khona
y-m-77-03.prereq.1: Isiphumo sokwahlula nentsalela, ukungalingani okuthe tye (inqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi)
y-m-77-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kwisibakala somsebenzi ongenasiseko okanye ongachanekanga.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uhlole ngokwakho ukuba amabalo emigca 1 no-3 aphumelela na.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yenza iindibaniselwano ezininzi ezisebenzisa iibhokisi ezinkulu ezingaphantsi kwezi-8, uhlole ukuba zonke iindawo ezili-100 ziyangena, uze ubale iindleko.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.0: Ibhokisi enkulu ixabisa i-1,500÷12 = 125 won ngento nganye, kwaye ibhokisi encinci ixabisa i-1,100÷8 = 137.5 won ngento nganye.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.1: Ngoko, ukusebenzisa iibhokisi ezinkulu ezininzi kangangoko kuyeyona ixabisa ngaphantsi.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.2: 100÷12 inesiphumo sokwahlula esi-8 nentsalela ye-4, ngoko sebenzisa iibhokisi ezinkulu ezi-8 (zezinto ezingama-96) nebhokisi encinci e-1 (yezi-4 ezisele).
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.3: Iindleko zi-1,500×8 + 1,100×1 = 13,100원, kwaye esi sesona sincinci kwiindleko.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.explain: Ukubala kwexabiso ngecandelo kumgca 1 nokubala kwesiqulatho nentsalela kumgca 3 kuchanekile. Umgca 2 wenza isigqibo esiqhelekileyo 'ngoyi ngexabiso eliphantsi ngecandelo ngalinye, ngoko sebenzisa iibhokisi ezininzi ngangoko' ngaphandle kwesizathu. Kwindlela yomgca 3, ibhokisi encinci enye inezithuba ezingama-4 ezingenanto, kodwa ukuba usebenzisa iibhokisi ezikhulu ezi-7 neebhokisi ezincinci ezi-2, ugcwalisa ncam izinto ezingama-84+16=100, kwaye iindleko zi-10,500+2,200=12,700원. I-13,100원 kumgca 4 asiyiyo eyona incinci. Nokuba ukhethe umgca 2 okanye umgca 4, ubone umgca ophosakeleyo.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa iibhokisi ezikhulu ezingama-a neebhokisi ezincinci ezingama-b, yenza iindibaniselwano zokupakisha ezibamba amalungu e-100 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye ezixabiso eliphantsi kune-13,100원 eyakhankanywa ngumsebenzi. a no-b ngamanani apheleleyo e-0 okanye ngaphezulu. Fumana iindibaniselwano ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tshintsha inani leebhokisi ezikhulu a libe yi-5, 6, 7, kunye ne-8, ufumane inani elincinci leebhokisi ezincinci ezifunekayo ukubamba izinto ezili-100.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kumgqatswa ngamnye, bhala kwitheyibhile ukuba inani lezithuba li-100 ubuncinane na nokuba iindleko zingaphantsi kwe-13,100, uze uhlole.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Inani leebhokisi linani eliphelele le-0 okanye ngaphezulu.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Inani leebhokisi kufuneka libe linani eliphelele le-0 okanye ngaphezulu.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Le ndibaniselwano ayinakubamba izinto ezili-100. Phinda ubale izithuba kwiibhokisi.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Iindleko zi-13,100원 okanye ngaphezulu. Khangela indibaniselwano eshiphu ngakumbi.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.explain: Iindibaniselwano kuphela ezanelisa iimeko zi-(7, 2) kunye ne-(5, 5). (7, 2) ibiza i-12,700원 kwaye inezithuba ezili-100 ncam. (5, 5) ibiza i-7,500+5,500=13,000원 kwaye inezithuba ezili-100 ncam. Akukho nanye enesithuba esingenanto. Indlela yokusebenzisa iibhokisi ezikhulu ezi-8 nokubeka eseleyo kwibhokisi encinci shiya izithuba ezingama-4 ezingenanto kwibhokisi encinci yokugqibela.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.prompt: Kwi-oda eliphi unokuthi ngokuqinisekileyo umthetho othi 'sebenzisa iibhokisi ezixabiso eliphantsi ngecandelo ngobuninzi, ubeke amalungu aseleyo kwibhokisi encinci' unika iindleko ezincinci kakhulu? (Amaxabiso nobukhulu beebhokisi ahlala enjalo.)
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kwi-oda ngalinye, thelekisa iindleko zokupakisha ngomthetho neendleko xa usebenzisa ibhokisi enye enkulu encinci kunye neebhokisi ezincinci ezininzi.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa ii-oda apho umthetho ushiya izithuba ezingenanto neeoda apho ungashiyi.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.a: Nakwi-98, iibhokisi ezikhulu ezi-7 neebhokisi ezincinci ezi-2 (12,700원) ziphantsi kuneebhokisi ezikhulu ezi-8 nebhokisi encinci e-1 (13,100원). Eli yi-oda apho umthetho uphukayo.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.b: Izithuba ziyahambelana ncam neebhokisi ezikhulu kuphela, kwaye akukho ndibaniselwano inexabiso eliphantsi kwesithuba, nesi sisiseko.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.c: Njengoko uhlolile ngoku, kwi-100 kukho indibaniselwano eshiphu kunoko umthetho onikayo.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.o.d: Injalo kwiioda zonke, nokuba zingaphi amalungu
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.d: Ukuthi ibamba kwiioda zonke, kufuneka ubonise ukuba akukho mzekelo ochasayo, kodwa sele kukho umzekelo ochasayo we-100.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.explain: Ama-96 ahlala ncam kwiibhokisi ezikhulu ezi-8, kwaye iindleko zi-12,000원. Kwindibaniselwano nayiphi na, ixabiso ngesithuba li-125원 ubuncinane kwaye kufuneka kubekho izithuba ezingama-96 ubuncinane, ngoko iindleko zi-125×96=12,000원 ubuncinane. Ngoko i-12,000원 yeyona incinci. Umthetho ulungile kwiioda apho iibhokisi ezixabiso eliphantsi ngecandelo zodwa zihlala ncam (imiphindaphindo ye-12), kwaye kwiioda ezintsalela kufuneka uhlole.

y-m-77-05.title: Xa wenza uluhlu lwamaxabiso ne-'margin ye-25%', kufuneka sibuze ntoni kuqala?
y-m-77-05.topic: Isiseko somlinganiselo we-margin nokumisela ixabiso lentengiso
y-m-77-05.goal: Yazi ukuba nepesenti efanayo inika ixabiso eliyahlukileyo ngokuxhomekeke kubungakanani apho ingumlinganiselo wabo, uze ubhale njengemibuzo isiseko ekufuneka usihlole phambi kokumisela ixabiso.
y-m-77-05.material: Ivenkile yezixhobo zokubhala ifuna ukumisela ixabiso lorhatshi lento enexabiso lomgangatho we-8,000원. Inkokeli yeqela yathi, 'Nceda umisele ixabiso lorhatshi nge-margin ye-25%.' I-margin yinzuzo yexabiso lorhatshi ukususa iindleko (ixabiso lorhatshi − iindleko), kwaye ungazihoyi irhafu nezinye iindleko. Umsebenzi 가 wathi, 'Yongeza i-25% yeendleko, ngoko 8,000×1.25=10,000원.' Umsebenzi 나 wathi, 'Isabelo se-margin kwixabiso lorhatshi kufuneka sibe yi-25%, ngoko ukuba ixabiso lorhatshi yi-P, ngoko (P−8,000)÷P=0.25, oko kukuthi P≈10,667원.'
y-m-77-05.thinking.0: Ukugweba ukuba ulwazi lwanele na nokukhomba oko kulahlekileyo
y-m-77-05.thinking.1: Ukwenza iimeko apho ixabiso lomlinganiselo litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kubungakanani besiseko
y-m-77-05.thinking.2: Ukubhala umyalezo ucela omnye ulwazi olufunekayo
y-m-77-05.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yeepesenti nemilinganiselo, ukusombulula iinkcazelo ezilayinini (inqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi)
y-m-77-05.s.s1.prompt: Luluphi isigwebo esifanelekileyo kakhulu malunga nokubala kwabasebenzi ababini?
y-m-77-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala umgca omnye ngamnye wento 가 no-나 abayisebenzise i-'25%' njengomlinganiselo wayo, uze uthelekise.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.hint.1: Usebenzisa ixabiso lorhatshi lomsebenzi ngamnye, bala i-margin ÷ iindleko kunye ne-margin ÷ ixabiso lorhatshi, uhlole ukuba leliphi lifikelela kwi-25%.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.a: Ukubala komsebenzi 가 kuchanekile. Ipesenti iphindaphindwa ngeendleko yongezwe, ngoko inkcazelo ka-나 ayifuneki
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ngeendleko kuphela. Ubungazange ucinge ukuba i-margin isenokuvakaliswa njengomlinganiselo wexabiso lorhatshi nayo.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.b: Ukubala komsebenzi 나 kuchanekile. Izinga lenzuzo lihlala livakaliswa njengomlinganiselo wexabiso lorhatshi, ngoko inkcazelo ka-가 iphosakele
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.b: Ucinge ngexabiso lorhatshi kuphela. Kuqhelekile ukuvakalisa izinga le-margin njengomlinganiselo weendleko nalo.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.c: Ukuba simisela malunga ne-10,333원, embindini wamaxabiso amabini, libonisa ukubala konke kwabasebenzi 가 no-나
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.c: Ukuxuba amaxabiso amabini kunika ixabiso elingahambelani nenkcazelo nenye. Into yokuba iziseko ziyahluka ayisonjululwanga.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.d: Zombini ukubala kuchanekile. Kufuneka sibuze inkokeli yeqela ukuba i-25% yimlinganiselo wantoni
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.d: Uqonde ukuba ukubala okubini kusebenzise iziseko ezahlukeneyo, wazama kuqala ukuqinisekisa ukuba sesiphi isiseko.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.explain: 가 utolike izinga le-margin njengomlinganiselo weendleko, kwaye 나 njengomlinganiselo wexabiso lorhatshi, kwaye ukubala kunye kuchanekile. 'Margin ye-25%' yodwa ayigqibi ukuba sesiphi isiseko, ngoko ixabiso lorhatshi alinakumiselwa libe linye. Ukuba ukhetha enye yezimbini ngokungenamkhethe, isenokwahluka koko inkokeli yeqela ikufunayo.
y-m-77-05.s.s2.prompt: Umahluko omkhulu phakathi kwamaxabiso orhatshi evela kutoliko oluyi-2, ilahleko enkulu evela ekungaqondini. Xa kukho iindleko ze-c원 kunye nezinga le-margin le-m%, yenza imizekelo emi-2 eyahlukileyo apho umahluko phakathi kwexabiso lorhatshi elisekelwe kwiindleko (c×(1+m÷100)) nexabiso lorhatshi elisekelwe kwixabiso lorhatshi (c÷(1−m÷100)) li-1,000원 okanye ngaphezulu. c linani lendalo kwiiyunithi ze-1,000원 (ukusuka kwi-1,000 ukuya kwi-100,000), kwaye m linani lendalo elisuka kwi-5 ukuya kwi-50. y-m-77-07.s.s3.hint.1: Yenza isivakalisi esinye esibeka eso sixa ecaleni komndilili, kwaye ujonge ukuba kukho nto ishiyekileyo enokukhohlisa umfundi.
y-m-77-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba amagama avimba umfundi ekucingeni ukuba 'uninzi lwabantu lunokuba luhlawulwa malunga ne-400만 원'?
y-m-77-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uchazile isizathu sokuba umndilili ube phezulu (umvuzo wenyanga ophezulu womntu omnye)?
y-m-77-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ubhale amanani ahambelana nedatha yokuqala?
y-m-77-07.s.s3.model.0: Imivuzo yenyanga (phambi kwerhafu) yabasebenzi abangama-5 yi-250, i-280, i-300, i-370, kunye ne-800만 원. Umndilili yi-400만 원, kodwa umvuzo wenyanga ophakathi yi-300만 원. Owona mncinci yi-250만 원 kwaye owona mkhulu yi-800만 원.
y-m-77-07.s.s3.model.1: Umndilili wemivuzo yenyanga yi-400만 원 (abantu abangama-5). Umvuzo wenyanga ophezulu womntu omnye (800만 원) unyusa umndilili, ngoko umvuzo wenyanga ophakathi yi-300만 원 kwaye abantu abane bahlawulwa ngaphantsi kwe-400만 원.
y-m-77-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Lo ngumphumo osebenzisa idatha yomzekelo (250, 280, 300, 370, 800). Ukuba umfundi usebenzise enye idatha ayenzileyo, umntu kufuneka ajonge ukuba amanani ayahambelana naloo datha.
